comingSoon.title: Not available yet
comingSoon.desc: The Seelegent service keeps these settings. They appear here once the new dashboard can read them.

appearance.label: Appearance
appearance.desc: Theme, fonts and motion. Saved in this browser only.

workers.label: Workers
workers.desc: How many workers run at once and which models they may use.

quota.label: Quota
quota.desc: How much quota to keep in reserve and how accounts take turns.

gates.label: Gates
gates.desc: Commands that must pass before work counts as done.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.desc: When and how Seelegent tells you something needs you.

hooks.label: Hooks
hooks.desc: Calls to other services when tasks change.

memory.label: Memory
memory.desc: Project facts given to every worker.

language.label: Language
language.desc: Language of the dashboard. Changes apply at once.

theme.label: Theme
theme.desc: Colours of the whole dashboard. Auto follows your system’s light or dark mode.
theme.keywords: colour color dark light mode palette

fileIcons.label: File icons
fileIcons.desc: Icons next to file names in the Files, Git and process views and in the terminal.
fileIcons.keywords: icon icons file type seti material jetbrains catppuccin

fontUi.label: Interface font
fontUi.desc: Only fonts installed on this computer are used; nothing is downloaded.

fontMono.label: Code font
fontMono.desc: Font for logs, diffs and terminals. Theme default uses the theme’s pick.

sizeUi.label: Interface text size
sizeUi.desc: Base size of text across the dashboard.

sizeTerm.label: Code text size
sizeTerm.desc: Size of text in logs, diffs and terminals.

lineHeightTerm.label: Code line spacing
lineHeightTerm.desc: Space between lines in logs and terminals.

motion.label: Motion
motion.desc: Animations and transitions. System follows your reduced-motion setting.

reset.label: Reset appearance
reset.desc: Back to the default theme, fonts, sizes and motion.

locale.label: Language
locale.desc: Browser default follows the languages your browser prefers.

concurrency.label: Workers at once
concurrency.desc: How many workers may run at the same time.

defaultTier.label: Default tier
defaultTier.desc: Model tier used when a brief does not name one.

modelCap.label: Model cap
modelCap.desc: The strongest model workers may use.

quotaReserve.label: Quota reserve
quotaReserve.desc: Share of each account’s quota kept free for urgent work.

rotation.label: Account rotation
rotation.desc: Move work to another account when one runs out of quota.

gateCommands.label: Gate commands
gateCommands.desc: Build and test commands that prove a task works.

gateBeforeReview.label: Run gates before review
gateBeforeReview.desc: Run the gates before a task is handed to you for review.

desktopNotify.label: Desktop notifications
desktopNotify.desc: Notify when a task needs review or a worker asks a question.

keymap.label: Shortcut keys
keymap.desc: See and change the keys for pages and commands.

webhooks.label: Webhooks
webhooks.desc: Addresses called when a task starts, finishes or fails.

projectMemory.label: Project memory
projectMemory.desc: Conventions, commands and pitfalls added to every brief.

experimental.label: Experimental features
experimental.desc: Turn on features that are still being tested.
